name: Navigation
purpose: derive navigation and hierarchy presentations from canonical SiteTree truth without creating a second hierarchy authority

projectionRecord.rule: projection records are detached immutable values and are not canonical SiteTree node references

global.semantics: ordered projection of the SiteTree root children

local.semantics: ordered projection of the exact current SiteTree node children; unknown current path or leaf yields an empty projection

breadcrumbs.semantics: root-to-current lineage including the current node; unaddressable structural nodes remain present with no invented path

sitemap.semantics: recursive detached projection of the complete canonical SiteTree

currentSection.semantics: the first node below the SiteTree root on the current lineage; unknown path or root itself yields null

shape.currentId: exact current node id or null

pathContext.unknown: unknown syntactically valid path produces empty/null inactive projection according to the projection return type
pathContext.mustNot: lowercase, append/remove slash, prefix-match or otherwise normalize current path identity

rules: Navigation is not an independent hierarchy authority
navigation identity, labels, paths and parent-child structure come from SiteTree
Navigation must not duplicate a separately maintained tree beside /site.json
projection records may be duplicated freely because they are not hierarchy authority
active state is derived from current page/path context and is not canonical SiteTree instance data
current section is derived from ancestry and is not stored separately
page actions and command buttons are Actions, not Navigation
Refresh and other page-data operations are not Navigation
API and service routing are separate machine-interface concerns and are not derived from the public SiteTree hierarchy
Navigation projections do not infer authorization from hierarchy or visibility
